note: Building a number from its name or expanded form, and pulling it apart: development cases for need 35P-05, 2026-11-25, written from blueprint.json in this folder (rows E1-E6). Used for design and tuning; the scoring set is separate, written later by a fresh agent from the blueprint alone, sealed. Never taken from the question set. PV-01 to PV-15 are cases this need serves (8 en-US, 7 zh-CN; 8 build, 7 pull_apart): expect.number is the number as a plain decimal string, expect.direction is build (name, place counts or expanded form to numeral) or pull_apart (numeral to its places, including one digit's value). PV-16 to PV-21 are near misses that belong to other needs (expect.need names it): the place-value chart must not be used. Chinese cases use 万级/个级 grouping and 十分位、百分位、千分位, as Chinese learners say them; Chinese decimals are built from place counts, not from a spoken name, since Chinese reads decimals digit by digit. expect.given (added 2026-11-25): the form the card shows — name, expanded (values), expanded_factors (digit × place value), place_counts (how many of each place), or numeral for pulling apart.
